sources.title: Huihui-Qwen3.5-9B-Abliterated: What This Uncensored Model Does
sources.snippet: Use the model in sandboxed environments to study refusal removal techniques and their implications for language model design. Consider running it via Ollama for easy local deployment and experimentation without external API dependencies. This is a simplified guide to an AI model called Huihui-Qwen3.5-9B-abliterated maintained by huihui-ai.

sources.title: Huihui Qwen3.5 9B abliterated — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A community-modified variant of Qwen3.5 9B that has undergone abliteration — a technique that removes refusal behaviors from the base model. This means it responds more freely to a wider range of prompts without built-in content restrictions. The trade-off is clear: safety guardrails are intentionally absent, so outputs require careful human oversight.
